bundle.shortDescription: Local-first Google Photos backup for Linux
bundle.longDescription: Photonic backs up photos and videos from your computer to Google Photos with a review step, live progress, safe retries, and a local history. It is a one-way backup tool: it never deletes or renames anything in Google Photos. Photonic is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Google, and it uses an unofficial upload path.
